top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov) rewards the complete, replicated and mature GLP-1 arc from proglucagon processing and the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide to glucose-dependent insulin secretion and drugs with confirmed benefit in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease. The citation is scoped to physiology and the active form, which keeps names and wording consistent and acknowledges the therapeutic consequence. Mojsov's priority is contested and Habener is omitted, but Mojsov is the only credited name tied to the active peptide. P002 (Knudsen in place of Mojsov) is a defensible second, since albumin binding and DPP-4 resistance were real invention, but it shifts the citation to a development reading. Awarding the same discovery is still better than no award.
